question: Why does the session middleware regenerate the session id after login instead of reusing it?
reference_answer: Reusing the pre-login session id allowed session fixation. Issue #412 reported the vulnerability and PR #418 changed login to rotate the id and invalidate the old session.
key_points: fix rotates the session id on login

question: Was an LRU cache considered for the token store before the current TTL-based design?
reference_answer: Yes. A reviewer on PR #530 argued LRU eviction could drop still-valid tokens under load, so the authors switched to TTL expiry.
key_points: rejected because valid tokens could be evicted
